sections.label: Trigger
sections.text: A creature or object enters the lava or starts their turn there, or starts their turn [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to the lava.

sections.label: Effect
sections.text: If the target is [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to lava but not in it, this ability takes a bane. A burning creature takes 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of their turns. A burning object takes 1d6 fire damage at the end of each round.

features.body: **Magma Flow (+4 EV)** The lava is flowing! At the start of each round, add one square of lava [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to an existing square of lava.
features.name: Upgrade

flavor: A patch of blisteringly hot molten rock wells up from the ground, threatening anyone who gets close to it.
name: Lava
